description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class manages project-related data operations, such as retrieving DAOs, validating project activities for duplication and existence, and mapping project activities to arrays. It interacts with data access objects and throws exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: ProjectService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing project and project activity data, including validation and mapping functions within the OrangeHRM time tracking plugin.

methods.name: getProjectDao
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProjectDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDao
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProjectActivityDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: validateProjectActivityName
methods.description: Validates that specified project activities are present and not duplicated between projects, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getProjectActivityAsMap
methods.description: Converts an array of ProjectActivity objects into a key-value map indexed by activity name.
